subject: Recap + POC alignment: success metrics, owners, and decision forum
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Summers <claire@crescohealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@crescohealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + POC alignment: success metrics, owners, and decision forum

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick write-up of what we agreed and a proposed next-step cadence so we can lock the POC plan in motion. Please review and confirm or flag changes by EOD Tuesday.

1) High-level goal (customer stated):
- Validate Redwood can reduce time-to-response for clinical documentation triage by at least 30% while keeping precision above 92% on key entity extraction (diagnosis, medication, procedure).

2) Success criteria (we proposed; you agreed to confirm):
- Latency: median response < 350ms for 512-token average payload (measured on test dataset)
- Accuracy: entity extraction F1 >= 0.92 on curated sample of 1,000 records
- Stability: no more than 2% error rate across daily runs for two consecutive weeks
- Ops: automated KV cache warm-up and repeat-request hit-rate > 40%

3) Proposed scope & artifacts (attachments):
- POC-success-metrics.xlsx — canonical metric definitions and scoring script
- mutual_action_plan.pdf — timeline and handoffs
- redwood_poc_runbook.md — runbook for on-call support and infra verification

4) Timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm success criteria and dataset access
- Week 1: test environment provisioning; sample ingestion (Redwood infra)
- Weeks 2–3: evaluation runs & incremental tuning (nightly batches + 1k sample checks)
- Week 4: internal readout + executive decision window (go/no-go)

5) Owners / roles:
- Customer lead: Claire Summers (Cresco)
- Redwood SE lead: Sean Gallagher — technical onboarding, integration checks
- Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole — run coordination, readiness, and exec readout prep
- Infra & privacy: Connor O'Brien — network/VPC, data handling checklist

6) Immediate asks for Cresco:
- Confirm the annotated sample for F1 calculation (share S3 link or DropBox by Tue)
- Provide names for procurement/billing contact (we need a PO path for Dedicated if you choose to proceed)

I can start provisioning the test cluster as soon as we have dataset access. If the criteria above look right, I’ll send a formal mutual action plan and calendar options for the executive readout (targeting week 4 end).

Thanks — short and practical here.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: POC-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (pdf)

Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + POC alignment: success metrics, owners, and decision forum

Thanks Hannah — this is very clear and matches what we discussed. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Confirmed: the annotated 1,000-record sample will be available as a gated S3 bucket by Tue 23:59 PT (we'll provide credentials).
- Slight tweak to timeline: the team requests an extra week of tuning (so evaluation runs during Weeks 2–4) — our clinical reviewer bandwidth is limited for the coming two weeks.
- Exec readout: Tom and I want a decision forum the week of June 6 (we're heavy that week but can do Wed/Thu morning PT). If Redwood can accommodate, we prefer the later slot to give us time to validate.

Also looping procurement: procurement@crescohealth.com (they'll evaluate the Dedicated pricing if we go that route).

Appreciate the clear owners — looking forward to Sean & Marissa kicking off.

Claire

Please take the items below and reply with A) done / B) ETA / C) blockers by EOD Monday.

- Kick off technical onboarding: validate sample S3 access + ingest pipeline (ETA: Tue EOD)
- Run initial latency profile on 512-token baseline and share median & p95 numbers (ETA: Wed)
- Work with Connor to ensure test cluster KV cache is configured per runbook

Marissa (CS lead) — tasks:
- Draft the mutual action plan (use attached template) and send to Claire for signature (ETA: Mon)
- Prepare the exec readout briefing slide deck template (metrics, risks, decision ask)

Connor (Infra/privacy) — tasks:
- Confirm VPC peering / IP allowlist requirements and share network checklist (ETA: Tue)
- Validate that logs/audit retention meets Cresco's security needs; flag anything needing legal

Other notes:
- I will update the HubSpot deal RDW-2028-324 with milestones and calendar invites.
- Procurement contact: procurement@crescohealth.com (mortgage). We'll need a billing contact and PO path if they decide to reserve Dedicated capacity.

Thanks — please keep replies short. If anything looks off I can jump on a quick sync with Sean & Marissa.

Hannah

I've attached a draft mutual_action_plan.pdf and the POC metric workbook — I'll incorporate Claire's tuning-week preference into the timeline. Sean/Connor — please confirm your ETAs in-thread so we can update the HUBSpot milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.
